jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.content: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Backend Engineer</strong> to own our batch data platform.</p><p>You will work in <strong>Python</strong> and <strong>Go</strong> on Airflow pipelines running on AWS, with dbt and Snowflake downstream. You will own the on-call rotation for the platform and set DAG-level SLAs.</p><p>Requirements: 5+ years backend engineering, strong Python, production Airflow experience, Terraform, and AWS. Remote within the EU.</p><script>tracking()</script>

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.content: <p>Lead a team of 8 infrastructure engineers. This is a people-management role with no hands-on coding expected.</p>
